problem: Calculate the sum to infinity of the geometric series $6.4+4.8+3.6+2.7+⋯$
worked_solution:
The sum to infinity ${S}_{\infty }$ of a geometric series is given by the formula

$$
{S}_{\infty }=\frac{{a}_{1}}{1-r},\,|r|<1,
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ is the first term and $r$ is the common ratio.

For the given geometric series, the first term is ${a}_{1}=6.4$ and the common ratio is

$$
r=\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{4.8}{6.4}=0.75.
$$

So, using the formula, we find that the sum to infinity is

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{\infty } & =\frac{{a}_{1}}{1-r} \\  & =\frac{6.4}{1-0.75} \\  & =\frac{6.4}{0.25} \\  & =25.6.\end{aligned}
$$
